phase_boundary: Generation only. Root must seal packet/rubric/reference before any independent reference or AI decision.

protocol.phase_boundary: Reference-free derivation only. Seal all packets, rubric, checker and tests before any reference or AI decisions. The separate replay phase requires global parent eligibility before child-source authorization.

resource_budget.AI_packet_limit_policy: Preflight complete-module packet size with a pinned tokenizer; at most64k input and8k output tokens per context. If a packet exceeds this budget, stop before reviewers; do not truncate a source module or replace its claims.
resource_budget.ceiling_policy: A resource stop preserves partial artifacts and failure status. It does not license dropping cases or silently shortening the registered horizon.
resource_budget.token_estimate_scope: o200k_base named research-envelope estimate, excludes harness/system/tool overhead and does not claim actual model context or billing. Responses checked after return against8k estimate.

protocol.resource_enforcement: Observed output storage, self plus completed-child CPU, and wall checks; one operation can overshoot before the next boundary. Preserve failure; no replacement or horizon change.
protocol.source_access: Only regular allowed package Python blobs of exactly the three frozen parents. No child source access. Separate committed explicit-blob provisioning precedes offline collection.

source_configuration.parser: Pinned CPython3.12; disclose shared ast infrastructure. Source is never imported or executed.
source_configuration.rules: No automatic root expansion or file-limit change. Unsupported modes, encodings, syntax or binding hazards are reported. Feasibility and exclusions are recorded before child access.
